---
# =============================================================================
# PAPER PAGE TEMPLATE  —  copy this into papers/, rename to papers/YYYY-slug.qmd,
# fill every blank, then delete these comment lines.
#
# This front matter is the ONLY part you edit. Quarto turns it into the hidden
# Google Scholar meta tags (citation_title, citation_author, citation_pdf_url, …).
# Requirements: v2 §3.3 (visible entry) + §4.1 (hidden tags).
# =============================================================================

title: "Exact title as published — do not paraphrase or shorten"
description: "Two–three sentence abstract. Reused as the citation_abstract tag and helps Google."

# Authors: same order as published, Surname + initials style is fine.
author:
  - name: R. Singh
  - name: A. Patil
  - name: S. Deshmukh

citation:
  type: article-journal
  container-title: "Bioresource Technology"     # journal name, exact
  volume: "371"
  page: "128-139"                                # split on the hyphen automatically
  issued: "2023"                                 # publication year (or YYYY-MM)
  doi: "10.xxxx/xxxxx"
  # pdf-url is THE most important line — it becomes citation_pdf_url, the tag that
  # points Google Scholar at your free PDF and merges it under "All versions".
  # Use the full public URL, not a relative path:
  pdf-url: "https://drrichasingh.in/papers/2023-biochar-dye.pdf"

# Emit the Scholar meta tags for this page. (Set only on paper pages.)
google-scholar: true
---
